scope: ECONOVA-S and NAAIL publication-grade scientific discovery workflows

scientific_method_inspirations.co_scientist: hypothesis generation, critique, ranking, evolution and meta-review
scientific_method_inspirations.era: conversion of scientific problems into executable empirical software and scorable tests

scientific_method_inspirations.science_one: Chain-of-Evidence and CoE Audit for verifiability
scientific_method_inspirations.mirendil: closed-loop R&D acceleration and failure-driven iteration; not a Google product
